The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Editorial gateways for the NOAA glossary's Florida Current, Gulf Stream, and North Atlantic Current segments, respectively. These points do not form one measured system centerline or determine total system length.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: NOAA's glossary defines a continuous system comprising the Florida Current, Gulf Stream, and North Atlantic Current. The whole system extends beyond the Grand Banks toward the British Isles, so no 3,000 km Florida-to-Grand-Banks span is treated as its complete length.
